comment: Read from src/AMDecoder.cpp at commit 7008233, version 2.0.0 and the head of the repository. The follower is the Befaco Rampage slew shape with its shape fixed at 0, so it is always linear. The knob range comes out of two steps: paramToMinTime at src/AMDecoder.cpp:145 maps the knob onto 1e-3 to 1e-1 seconds, and src/AMDecoder.cpp:91 multiplies that by two raised to the knob value, giving 1ms at the bottom and about 0.2 seconds at the top. The switch's default branch, which would return 1.0, cannot be reached, because the knob is clamped to 0 and 1 and so the index never exceeds 5. The gate threshold is a fixed 2V on the finished output, at src/AMDecoder.cpp:121, not the half-range point the README describes. The endOfCyclePulse, trigger and mode_button_trigger members declared at src/AMDecoder.cpp:40 to 42 are never used. Both output jacks are written only inside the isConnected test at src/AMDecoder.cpp:118, so unplugging the input leaves them frozen.
